name: The Girl With The Bow
summary: The story behind this is that I almost lost someone very close and dear to me (fortunately, in the end, I didn’t), so I decided to reflect on how I was feeling through a mod. In practice, the themes addressed in the mod are vague enough (I think) for you to be able to imagine anyone; maybe you yourself can relate to it. I hope you like this little thing I made and maybe, just maybe… it can be helpful in some way.
